data.title: Articles of Incorporation
data.content:
# Articles of Incorporation of the Corporation

## Article I: Name
The name of the corporation shall be as designated in this blockchain ledger.

## Article II: Purpose
The purpose of the corporation is to engage in any lawful act or activity for which corporations may be organized under the General Corporation Law.

## Article III: Authorized Capital Stock
The total number of shares of stock which the corporation shall have authority to issue is 10,000,000 shares of Common Stock, par value $0.0001 per share.

## Article IV: Board of Directors
The business and affairs of the corporation shall be managed by or under the direction of the Board of Directors. The initial Board shall be ratified upon genesis.

## Article V: LegitBlock Protocol
All corporate records, minutes, stock ledgers, and amendments shall be cryptographically maintained and ratified on the LegitBlock blockchain.
data.notes: Initial founding document ratified at genesis

data.title: Corporate Bylaws
data.content:
# Corporate Bylaws

## Section 1: Stockholders Meetings
1.1 Annual Meeting: Held annually at a time and date fixed by the Board of Directors.
1.2 Notice: Notice shall be given not less than 10 nor more than 60 days before the meeting date.
1.3 Quorum: A majority of the voting power of the shares entitled to vote shall constitute a quorum.

## Section 2: Board of Directors
2.1 Powers: The business and affairs of the Corporation shall be managed by its Board of Directors.
2.2 Election and Term: Directors shall be elected at each annual meeting of stockholders.
2.3 Action by Blockchain Vote: Any action required or permitted to be taken at any meeting of the Board may be taken by cryptographic vote on the LegitBlock ledger.

## Section 3: Officers
3.1 Executive Officers: The officers of the Corporation shall include a Chief Executive Officer, President, Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer.
data.notes: Initial founding document ratified at genesis

data.title: Initial Board Resolutions
data.content:
# Action by Unanimous Written Consent of the Initial Board of Directors

The undersigned, constituting all the directors of the Corporation, hereby adopt the following resolutions:

1. Adoption of Bylaws: The Bylaws presented to the Board are hereby adopted as the Bylaws of this Corporation.
2. Election of Officers: The founding executive officers are hereby elected to their designated roles.
3. Adoption of LegitBlock: Resolved that the LegitBlock blockchain shall serve as the official, authoritative record of corporate governance and document ratifications.
data.notes: Initial founding document ratified at genesis
